decisions.reason: The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates both Small Block and Big Block prize copy to the new quantities and cadence; no further change is required.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already incorporates the revised Small Block and Big Block prize explanation into the FAQ baseline.
The existing message-158 MODIFY fully records one $500 winner, a $500 pool per draw, and a draw every 100 sales; the unchanged ticket and funding attributes remain valid.
The existing message-158 MODIFY fully records one winner, a $10,000 prize pool, and a 10,000-sales trigger; the unchanged $10,000 per-winner amount and other mechanics remain valid.
Changing block-prize quantities and cadence does not change the current or conditional future project names.
The source changes prize quantities and draw cadence but does not decide whether prizes use automatic delivery or a claim flow.
The block-prize adjustment does not change the $5 coded-referral commission, its recipient, timing, or delivery behavior.
Message 158 does not remove or modify Aave yield behavior; the later statement that Aave becomes unnecessary cannot be propagated from this source Event.
The client explicitly preserves the same net giveaway amount, and the new Small and Big Block schedules retain the existing aggregate $6 prize allocation per sale.
Changing prize quantities and draw cadence does not alter how the book, referral code, badges, or active and expired tickets behave on NFT transfer.
The source does not change the flat secondary royalty, founder allocation, prize-pool funding from royalties, or the rule that secondary sales do not generate referral tickets.
The revised block-prize quantities and cadence do not change fiat-user dashboard access or wallet requirements for commissions and prize tickets.
